name: globe
blurb: Draggable 3D globe with auto-rotation and spring physics for smooth interaction.
description: Renders a COBE-powered interactive globe with location markers. Rotates automatically; drag to rotate manually with spring damping. Customizable colors, diffuse, and map samples.
use_when: Hero sections or dashboards showcasing global reach or data distribution.
avoid_when: Mobile-first designs or performance-sensitive pages. Requires canvas support.
a11y: Purely visual 3D rendering. Drag is mouse/touch only, no keyboard alternative.
